node.label: Reduced erythrocyte galactose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase activity
node.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of galactose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase (GALT; EC 2.7.7.12) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
